This run is finished:

Type over any hours or amounts to correct the client's submission. Regular hours blank = usual hours (hourly) or full salary. Use + Add hours for overtime, vacation, sick, stat holiday or other hours, and for bonuses or one-time amounts. Overtime is paid at 1.5×; vacation pay follows each employee's setting (4%, or 6% after 5 years). Approve, then Generate: paystubs (PDF), email drafts and the records are created together. Client asked for a change after paystubs went out? Click Correct this pay run, fix the amounts, then Approve and Generate: only the employees whose pay changed get a paystub marked REVISED. Small adjustments can also go in the next pay (Other earnings or a one-time deduction).

Record of Employment (ROE) data

Use these figures to file on CRA's T4 web forms or ROE Web. Insurable hours and earnings use the last 53 weeks of pay periods (53 weekly, 27 bi-weekly, 25 semi-monthly, 13 monthly).

Archive or delete

Archive a company that's no longer active or has no employees: it disappears from the dashboard, reminders and PD7A emails stop, and the client can no longer sign in to the portal. All its payroll records stay here for year-end, T4s and CRA (keep payroll records for 6 years). You can restore it any time.

Settings

Email wording

You can use {company}, {contact}, {start}, {end}, {paydate}, {deadline}, {firm}; for paystub emails also {count}, {net}, {remit}, {due}, and for employee emails {first} and {employee}.

Client portal

Shared records for the whole office

With shared records on, every company, employee and pay run is kept in your Supabase database, so everyone who signs in sees and updates the same records. SINs are stored encrypted, and every change is logged with who made it.

  1. Click Copy the shared-records script, paste it in Supabase › SQL Editor › New query and click Run (once for the office).
  2. On your computer (the one with all the records), sign in above and click Turn on shared records: your records become the office's records.
  3. Add each staff member below, then give them the Payroll Centre (Download ready-to-use copy for my team). They sign in and click Turn on shared records.

Each company has its own private link (Setup tab), sent in every reminder. While this page is open and connected it checks the portal every 3 minutes, brings new submissions in automatically and shows an alert.

Microsoft 365 email: reminders, PD7As and client sign-in codes

A reminder goes out at 9:00 a.m. on the reminder day (the "Remind clients" days before the deadline, set above), and a second one on the deadline morning if payroll still isn't in. Both stop as soon as the client submits. The PD7A goes only to the client (the company contact and its Cc). A corrected month sends a REVISED PD7A.
  1. Sign in at entra.microsoft.com as a Microsoft 365 admin. Go to App registrations › New registration, name it Payroll Centre, keep "this organizational directory only" and click Register. Copy the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID into the boxes below.
  2. In the new app: API permissions › Add a permission › Microsoft Graph › Application permissions, tick Mail.Send, click Add permissions, then Grant admin consent.
  3. Certificates & secrets › New client secret (24 months). Copy the secret's Value (shown once) into the box below.
  4. Enter the mailbox that sends (for example payroll@yourfirm.ca), click Create setup script, paste it in Supabase › SQL Editor › New query and click Run (if asked about RLS, choose "Run without RLS").
  5. Click Send me a test email. When it arrives, choose Email + one-time code under Client sign-in.
